description: Synergy's curated multi-product bundles ('programs'), each sold at a combined pack price cheaper than the constituent products bought separately. Packs never enter ProductResolver's scoring or ranking - PackResolver offers one as an optional extra alongside the single top-ranked product, only when the pack's formulatedFor.exactFor matches one of the person's selected wellness goals. Contents and pricing for PAK001-PAK007, PAK011 and PAK012 are taken directly from Synergy's official 'Product Pricelist UK - JULY 2026' (SKU-level). PAK008-PAK010 (the three 'Everyday' bundles) do NOT appear in that pricelist at all - their contents/pricing are still Claude's best read of the Synergy shop's own product-shot images and need Simon to confirm these are current, separately-run bundles.
